title: Weight of two restriction stages
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\delta_1,\delta_2\in\mathbb{R}$, and assign to each coordinate in $[n]$ an ordered pair of coordinate restrictions. The two-stage weight is the product over coordinates of the first-stage restriction's weight at parameter $\delta_1$ multiplied by the second-stage restriction's weight at parameter $\delta_2$.
hypotheses_covered: A pair of coordinate restrictions assigned to each coordinate in $[n]$
